card.name: Inside Latin and Romance-language terms
card.fires_on: The word ending partway through a non-English (Spanish, French, Latin) term in English text, such as Comunidad, corpora lutea, Chemins de Fer, or alopecia. The word is usually unfinished or is followed by a foreign word.

modes.label: Spanish or French names
modes.description: Part of a Spanish or French organisation name or phrase inside English text.
modes.example: Instituto Universitario de Integración en la Com<<unidad>> [INICO]

modes.label: Latin anatomy and medical terms
modes.description: Partway through Latin plural or medical terms like corpora or alopecia.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated and mixed across languages, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of foreign-language or Latin terms that appear inside English text.
